findings.title: State file regression from build agent
findings.detail: Build agent reset cycle from 1 to 0 and cleared history array, losing pipeline tracking of cycle 1 (review:clean, verify:clean). Cycle counter should be incremented, not reset. Previous history entries should be preserved.

findings.title: Redundant gl.disableVertexAttribArray(aPosF) call
findings.detail: aPosF is already disabled at line 2524 (unconditionally after moon block). The additional disable at line 2565 is redundant. Harmless but unnecessary.
